title: Myelin pathology is a key feature of X-linked dystonia-parkinsonism
title_zh: 髓鞘病理是X连锁肌张力障碍-帕金森病的关键特征
abstract: X-linked dystonia-parkinsonism (XDP) is an adult-onset movement disorder predominantly affecting males of Filipino descent. It is caused by the insertion of a SINE-variable number of tandem repeat (VNTR)-Alu subfamily F (SVA_F) retrotransposon in the TATA-box binding protein-associated factor 1 (TAF1) gene. A barrier to XDP research has been the lack of animal models. Here, we introduce a conditional humanized XDP mouse model harboring a hybrid mouse-human Taf1/TAF1 gene (hyTAF1) containing the pathogenic SVA_F. We activated hyTAF1 in Nestin+ cells and found the resulting XDP male mice recapitulate features of human XDP, including severe motor impairment and striatal atrophy. Transcriptomic, histological, and electron microscopy analyses revealed a reduction in oligodendrocyte-lineage cells and myelin disruption. Consistent with this, postmortem brain tissue from XDP patients revealed similar myelin pathology, including loss of myelin in the medial prefrontal cortex. These results identify oligodendrocyte dysfunction and myelin loss as major contributors to XDP, providing new mechanistic insight into this disorder.
abstract_zh: X连锁肌张力障碍-帕金森病（XDP）是一种成人发病的运动障碍，主要影响菲律宾血统的男性。它由TATA盒结合蛋白相关因子1（TAF1）基因中一种SINE-可变数串联重复-亞家族F（SVA_F）逆转录子的插入引起。XDP研究的一个障碍是缺乏动物模型。这里，我们引入了一种携带杂交小鼠-人Taf1/TAF1基因（hyTAF1）的条件性人源化XDP小鼠模型，该基因含有致病性SVA_F。我们在Nestin+细胞中激活了hyTAF1，发现由此产生的XDP雄性小鼠重现了人类XDP的特征，包括严重的运动障碍和纹状体萎缩。转录组学、组织学和电镜分析显示少突胶质细胞谱系细胞减少及髓鞘破坏。与此一致，XDP患者的尸检脑组织显示了类似的髓鞘病理，包括内侧前额叶皮层的髓鞘丢失。这些结果确认少突胶质细胞功能障碍和髓鞘丢失是XDP的主要诱因，为该疾病提供了新的机制性洞见。
